src/ble-service.ts.name: Bluetooth devices
src/ble-service.ts.description: Lets napplets find and talk to Bluetooth devices through host hooks, after approval.

src/browser-gamepad.ts.name: Browser controller reader
src/browser-gamepad.ts.description: Connects the browser's game controller readings and window focus changes to the controller service.

src/gamepad-service.ts.name: Game controllers
src/gamepad-service.ts.description: Shares controller button and stick readings with subscribed napplets, but only the one that has focus.

src/keys-service-internals.ts.name: Shortcut helpers
src/keys-service-internals.ts.description: Parses and formats key combinations, blocks reserved keys and tracks which napplet owns each shortcut.

src/keys-service.ts.name: Keyboard shortcuts
src/keys-service.ts.description: Listens for key presses and tells the napplet that registered a matching shortcut, with a swappable source for desktop shells.

src/serial-service.ts.name: Serial ports
src/serial-service.ts.description: Lets napplets open and use serial port devices through host hooks, after approval.

src/webrtc-service.ts.name: Peer-to-peer connections
src/webrtc-service.ts.description: Lets napplets open WebRTC connections that the shell sets up and approves on their behalf.
